items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report $1,200 (used unit) to about $5,000. Acura's 7-year/100,000-mile extension has ended.

items.t: Second gear can break from overheating (recall)
items.job: Revise oil cooler line or replace transmission
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifting problems and failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A fluid change is the first step if it is only shifting roughly.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Older driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver airbag inflator
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Engine stalls from worn ignition switch (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Key comes out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace key cylinder interlock parts
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Front lower ball joints wear out (recall)
items.note: Free if the recall was never done. If it was, worn joints later are a normal repair.

items.t: Car can roll while in Park (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Timing belt can break from misaligned pulley (recall)
items.job: Inspect/replace water pump and timing belt
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Airbag (SRS) light on
items.job: Replace seat belt buckle switch or SRS control module
items.note: A buckle switch is the cheaper fix; RepairPal lists the SRS module at about $1,235-$1,355.

items.t: Worn engine mounts cause vibration
items.note: RepairPal estimate for 2001-2003; replacing a single mount costs less.

items.t: Cranks but won't start when hot
items.job: No-start diagnosis and fuel injection (main) relay replacement
items.note: Diagnosis is about $120-$180 at RepairPal; the relay itself is inexpensive.

items.t: Power steering fluid leak and pump whine
items.job: Replace leaking power steering hose or O-rings and flush fluid
items.note: O-rings alone cost much less than a hose.

items.t: HID headlight flickering or going out
items.note: A failed ballast adds to the cost.

items.t: Misfire from failed ignition coil
items.note: RepairPal estimate for 2001-2003; a single front-bank coil costs much less.

items.t: Front axle failure or vibration
items.note: RepairPal dealer-level estimate; aftermarket axles cost far less.

items.t: Brake vibration or noise from rusted rotors
items.note: New rotors typically add $100-$200 in parts.

items.t: Check engine light from clogged EGR passages
items.job: Clean EGR passages and replace EGR valve
items.note: Cleaning alone is cheaper if the valve still works.

items.t: Driver power window stops working
Speedometer reads slower than actual speed
items.note: If the gauge itself is faulty, cluster repair costs more.

items.t: Starter fails to crank the engine
items.note: Clean the battery terminals first; corrosion causes the same symptom.
